title: Polish4Sodium
description: An unofficial Polish translation for Sodium/Embeddium.
body:
### ![favicon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fca00fbe48cb9b9731b88956ac79bfc29baa893.png) Polish4Sodium

#### About project
Polish4Sodium an unofficial translation for [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium). If you don't know, [Translations for Sodium](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/translations-for-sodium) has a lot of problems with text going off-screen, poor translation, or simply not translating something you might care about. This resourcepack was created so you can finally sleep soundly and enjoy playing Minecraft without straining and translating something in Sodium.

#### Supported mods:
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**
- **[Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/embeddium)**
- [Chloride](https://modrinth.com/mod/chloride)

#### FAQ - simply the most common questions

<details>
<summary>View FAQ</summary>

**Can i use it in my modpack?**

Yes, of course. You do not need permission to do that.

**Something isn't translated**

Report it on GitHub (for now not pinned)

**Can it work with every version of Minecraft/[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)?**

Very possible, but not a 100% chance

**Will there be other languages?**

No - reason is simple: "Polish"4Sodium, not Translations4Sodium

**Resourcepack has a red background in menu!**

Chill, its normal, it was originally created for 1.21.1 but works on every version _(if you use universal release)_ of Sodium/Embeddium/Minecraft

**What about other mods...?**

In the future.

**Old versions of Embeddium/Sodium works in half**

This is normal because older versions of these mods had a lot of hardcore stuff

</details>

## FAQ
### Can i use it in my modpack?
Yes, of course. You do not need permission to do that.
### Something isn't translated
Report it on GitHub (for now not pinned)
### Can it work with every version of Minecraft/[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)?
Very possible, but not a 100% chance
### Will there be other languages?
No - reason is simple: "Polish"4Sodium, not Translations4Sodium
### Resourcepack has a red background in menu!
Chill, its normal, it was originally created for 1.21.1 but works on every version _(if you use universal release)_ of Sodium/Embeddium/Minecraft
### What about other mods...?

This is normal because older versions of these mods had a lot of hardcore stuff
